budget.authorization: Greg Starling, Claude Code chat reply received 2026-10-09 after 23:00Z: "option 3 and /ship". Approves option 3 as presented: full routing-pack renewal with fresh frontier preflight, Claude smoke and Fable calibration renewal, replacement of retired gpt-5.3-codex-spark and retiring gpt-5.5 Codex treatments with gpt-6-luna/gpt-6-sol workers and a gpt-6-astra reviewer, and the 14-case installed acceptance re-run, within the presented upper estimate of 62 model executions; publication through /ship.

limitations: Provisional evidence only: smokes, calibration and installed acceptance grant no governor qualification and no measured savings.
Codex CLI JSON and native rollouts record configured model and effort only; served Codex identity and effort are not attested.

Claude workers launched through the Agent tool use model aliases with no effort control; served models come from forwarded child message models. A configured-effort treatment such as Sonnet 5/low cannot be matched by an Agent launch.

Two first-attempt Claude smoke reviews (claude and claude-haiku) were rejected by the unchanged assembler verdict format after giving correct verdicts outside the first token; both are preserved, counted and superseded by retries. The smoke reviewer prompt now asks the reviewer to begin with the verdict word.

Installed acceptance ran on the intermediate consumer folder and pack recorded in folder_freeze; the published pack is recompiled afterward with those records, so no live run of the exact published folder is claimed.
Codex per-execution USD pricing is unknown (plan credits); Claude rates are official API list prices, not subscription bills.
OpenAI's docs recommend GPT-6.1 Sol when available; it was not evaluated, and the Codex roles remain gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna workers with a gpt-6-astra frontier.

The Claude 5.5 generation (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5) was not evaluated; the pack's Claude treatments remain claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, all listed active. Haiku 4.5's earliest possible retirement (2026-10-15) falls inside the entry window; consumers skip unavailable treatments.
Rendered UI inspection was performed by the maintainer session from headless screenshots and DOM checks, not by a separate counted model execution.
Raw artifacts remain local under artifacts/renewal-2026-10-09 (gitignored); committed files bind their digests.

Two Codex child writes were shell heredoc commands in preserved native sessions rather than patch events: search.mjs (codex-hardbug) and store.mjs (codex-fullproject, call call_59225b2925754a528582fa76f1b89319).

The intermediate pack 357665d4 was compiled with the archived September acceptance file (ca5df227) as a placeholder; it matched no renewed treatment, so every entry in that pack was smoke extrapolation.
